items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: when I took him to England, the English guys, Lorry Wright and John Chilton and all of them, I mean they were just flabbergasted because he remembered everything.

ctx.x: Yeah. Edgar Hayes and King Oliver in the 30s. And so Clyde was, I mean when I took him to England, the English guys, Lorry Wright and John Chilton and all of them, I mean they were just flabbergasted because he remembered everything. In fact there’s a book written about him called I Remember by a wonderful jazz researcher, now his name escapes me. He is deceased. He lived in Brooklyn. Oh well.
You got to collaborate with Congressman John Conyers.
